title: Courtesy Shuttle
premise: The afterlife boards like a regional airport. The gate is polite. The weather system in first class is a carry-on dispute.
visual: Night concourse, almost empty. A polite LED board reads NOW BOARDING: EVERYONE. A glamorous bored gate agent in a black uniform scans tickets that are blank black rectangles. One passenger in heels is arguing that a hatbox containing a small, still-lit thundercloud is a personal item. Far down the jet bridge: only fog and a single red exit lamp.
characterLean: Vivienne would argue the cloud. Liliane would have read the bag policy and left.
